assert d["schema_version"] == 5
assert d["figure_kind"] == "kaplan_meier"
assert d["method"] == "kaplan_meier"

obs=d["observations"]
group_labels=d["group_labels"]
z=1.959963984540054
all_max=max(float(o["time"]) for o in obs)
risk_times=[]
for x in np.linspace(0.0, all_max, 5):
    x=float(x)
    if not any(abs(x-y)<1e-12 for y in risk_times):
        risk_times.append(x)

groups=[]
plot_groups=[]
total_n=0
for gi,label in enumerate(group_labels):
    rows=[o for o in obs if o["group"] == gi]
    n=len(rows); total_n+=n
    event_n=sum(bool(o["event"]) for o in rows)
    censored_n=n-event_n
    times=sorted(set(float(o["time"]) for o in rows))
    S=1.0
    greenwood_sum=0.0
    points=[]
    for t in times:
        r=sum(float(o["time"]) >= t for o in rows)
        de=sum(float(o["time"]) == t and bool(o["event"]) for o in rows)
        cc=sum(float(o["time"]) == t and not bool(o["event"]) for o in rows)
        if de:
            S *= (1.0 - de/r)
            if r-de > 0:
                greenwood_sum += de/(r*(r-de))
            # If r-d == 0, S becomes 0 boundary; variance unavailable by contract.
        if S == 1.0 or S == 0.0:
            var=lo=hi=None
            reason="boundary_survival_interval_unavailable"
        else:
            var=(S*S)*greenwood_sum
            se_g=math.sqrt(greenwood_sum)/abs(math.log(S))
            g=math.log(-math.log(S))
            lo=math.exp(-math.exp(g + z*se_g))
            hi=math.exp(-math.exp(g - z*se_g))
            reason=None
        points.append({
            "time":t,
            "n_at_risk":r,
            "n_event":de,
            "n_censored":cc,
            "survival":S,
            "greenwood_variance":var,
            "ci_low":lo,
            "ci_high":hi,
            "ci_reason":reason
        })
    rt=[]
    for t in risk_times:
        rt.append({
            "time":t,
            "n_at_risk":sum(float(o["time"]) >= t for o in rows),
            "events_before":sum(float(o["time"]) < t and bool(o["event"]) for o in rows),
            "censored_before":sum(float(o["time"]) < t and not bool(o["event"]) for o in rows)
        })
    gobj={
        "label":label, "n":n, "event_n":event_n, "censored_n":censored_n,
        "max_time":max(float(o["time"]) for o in rows) if rows else None,
        "points":points, "risk_table":rt
    }
    groups.append(gobj)
    plot_groups.append((rows, points))

# Strict finite JSON check.
def check_finite(x):
    if isinstance(x, dict):
        for v in x.values(): check_finite(v)
    elif isinstance(x, list):
        for v in x: check_finite(v)
    elif isinstance(x, float):
        if not math.isfinite(x):
            raise ValueError("non-finite")
check_finite(result)

line_styles=["-","--",":","-."]

all_handles=[]

for i,((rows,points), entry) in enumerate(zip(plot_groups,legend_entries)):
    color=entry["color"]
    ls=line_styles[i % len(line_styles)]
    marker=censor_markers[i % len(censor_markers)]
    # Step coordinates: origin at (0,1), then each observed time with post steps.
    xs=[0.0]+[p["time"] for p in points]
    ys=[1.0]+[p["survival"] for p in points]
    ax.step(xs,ys,where="post",color=color,linestyle=ls,linewidth=2.0,zorder=3)
    # Confidence band where available; post-step.
    valid=[p for p in points if p["ci_low"] is not None]
    if valid:
        bx=[valid[0]["time"]]+[p["time"] for p in valid]
        blo=[valid[0]["ci_low"]]+[p["ci_low"] for p in valid]
        bhi=[valid[0]["ci_high"]]+[p["ci_high"] for p in valid]
        # Extend to max follow-up using final point.
        if bx[-1] < all_max:
            bx.append(all_max); blo.append(blo[-1]); bhi.append(bhi[-1])
        ax.fill_between(bx,blo,bhi,step="post",color=color,alpha=0.17,linewidth=0,zorder=1)
    # censor marks at exact event-first survival.
